Also, importantly, verify the response is valid when stdout is a pipe (not a tty) ✓.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, os, subprocess, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import harness
site = harness.setup_env()
fx = json.load(open('/workspace/examples.json'))
data = json.dumps(fx[0]['request'], separators=(',',':')).encode()
env = {'PATH':'/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin','HOME':'/tmp','LANG':'C','LC_ALL':'C',
       'PYTHONHASHSEED':'0','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS':'1','OMP_NUM_THREADS':'1','MKL_NUM_THREADS':'1',
       'SYNECDOCHE_SITE':str(site),'LD_LIBRARY_PATH':'/workspace/native',
       'PYTHONUNBUFFERED':'1','PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'}
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/run.py'], input=data,
                   capture_output=True, env=env, cwd='/tmp')
print('rc', p.returncode, 'stderr', p.stderr[:400])
out = json.loads(p.stdout)
print('match', harness.equivalent(out, fx[0]['response']))
# empty stdin
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/run.py'], input=b'',
                   capture_output=True, env=env, cwd='/tmp')
print('empty ->', p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr[-200:])
PYEOF
